reason: The case asserts rejection of object fields and self references in method default expressions. Class and object method defaultable parameters are supported, so those negative checks alone are in scope. However, Class6–Class8 also assert name-resolution diagnostics inside nested anonymous object-constructor expressions, which are absent from the supported expression list; these are essential to the whole case.
